instruction: Open workspace1.code-workspace and workspace2.code-workspace in split vertical mode within a single VSCode window.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because VSCode cannot display two workspace files simultaneously in a split vertical mode within a single window. Workspaces are mutually exclusive - only one workspace can be active in a VSCode window at a time.

llm_judge_reasons: The task has been correctly identified as infeasible
The explanation accurately describes the technical limitation: VSCode workspaces are mutually exclusive - only one workspace can be active per window at a time
The 'infeasible' evaluator function is the appropriate marker for tasks that cannot be completed due to fundamental technical constraints
The instruction asks to open two workspace files in split vertical mode within a single VSCode window, which is impossible with VSCode's workspace model
